note: amende de la Commission (shopping) ; appel interjeté le 11 septembre 2017 ; amende incluse dans les charges à payer, garanties bancaires fournies au lieu d'un paiement
quote: On June 27, 2017, the EC announced its decision that certain actions taken by Google regarding its display and ranking of shopping search results and ads infringed European competition law. The EC decision imposed a €2.4 billion ($2.7 billion as of June 27, 2017) fine.

note: charge comptabilisée au deuxième trimestre 2017 pour l'amende shopping
quote: We recognized a charge of $2.7 billion for the fine in the second quarter of 2017.

note: amende de la Commission (Android) ; appel interjeté le 9 octobre 2018 ; le fait balisé en EUR porte sur le deuxième trimestre 2018, pas sur la date de décision
quote: On July 18, 2018, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's Android-related distribution agreements infringed European competition law. The EC decision imposed a €4.3 billion ($5.1 billion as of June 30, 2018) fine and directed the termination of the conduct at issue.

note: charge comptabilisée au deuxième trimestre 2018 pour l'amende Android
quote: We recognized a charge of $5.1 billion for the fine in the second quarter of 2018.

note: amende de la Commission (AdSense for Search) ; appel interjeté le 4 juin 2019
quote: On March 20, 2019, the EC announced its decision that certain contractual provisions in agreements that Google had with AdSense for Search partners infringed European competition law. The EC decision imposed a fine of €1.5 billion ($1.7 billion as of March 20, 2019)

note: charge comptabilisée au premier trimestre 2019 ; les faits balisés de 1,7 Md$ portent sur le 20 mars 2019 (contre-valeur à la décision) et sur le deuxième trimestre 2019, pas sur ce trimestre
quote: We recognized a charge of $1.7 billion for the fine in the first quarter of 2019.

note: garanties bancaires fournies pour les trois amendes de la Commission en lieu et place d'un paiement pendant les appels ; banques émettrices non nommées ; bénéficiaire : EC ; aucun montant publié pour les garanties
quote: While each EC decision is under appeal, we included the fines in accrued expenses and other current liabilities on our Consolidated Balance Sheets as we provided bank guarantees (in lieu of a cash payment) for the fines.

note: litige de droits d'auteur avec Oracle America, Inc. (contrepartie nommée) sans montant : perte raisonnablement possible non estimable ; indemnités génériques et enquêtes du DOJ sans montant
quote: In 2010, Oracle America, Inc. ("Oracle") brought a copyright lawsuit against Google in the Northern District of California, alleging that Google's Android operating system infringes Oracle's copyrights related to certain Java application programming interfaces.
